name: Effect: bow
notes: An effect for in front of any amp: no amp and no cab here, and auto_level off, so the bowed string comes out at about your guitar's level (about 0.5 V when you play hard). Your playing level is the bow's speed and force; a pluck becomes a long bowed note that fades in Hold; a hand on the strings lifts the bow. Physics: the bowed string (stick and slip). Not physics: the pitch tracker (20-30 ms after the pick). Too little Bow force whistles, too much grinds.
